baseline.scope: Prior actual 1440 frame resized to 1254 for comparison only

majorObservedProblems: The foreground ceiling wedge sloped the wrong way and the near right post was so distant that its foot appeared inside the frame.
The bridge was too long, its crest too far right, and independent bridge/hall stair runs did not share a coherent landing.
Wet path/drain boundaries did not follow the foreground veranda and near railing.
The entrance bay, pagoda body/finial and supporting hill needed whole-assembly placement/proportion corrections.
structuralChanges: The veranda roof/rafter assembly rotates 0.75 rad as one supported structure. Its cropped column, black shoe and chain-hung lamp share physical roof/support levels.

The right terminal moves from X 3.2, Z 8.0 to X 1.2, Z 11.8. Its shaft/finial proportions and complete returning rail now create a near foreground frame, with its foot below the image and a real supporting apron.

The path has new physical right-edge turning bounds and a column-foundation notch, closed worn curbs and an apron. Existing weathered-stone generation/PBR inputs remain. Drain mesh, actual clipping and wet-mask exclusion use the same 0.56275 rad angle.

The main hall moves as one assembly and its entrance/shrine/open bay shifts one local bay left. The pagoda and its supporting hill move together, with a revised whole-tier profile and finial height. The first tower floor meets the foundation top.

The bridge has 40 closed deck pieces, supporting girders/piers and an entrance abutment. Seven closed approach steps meet the side path datum. The former independent 25-step and 10-step hall runs are replaced by one 12-step flight with a turning landing and a full-width upper wedge landing.

The final correction moves the rising hall flight beyond the full bridge-deck footprint, expands the turning landing, opens the inner guard from t 0.82 and joins the remaining guard to the outside stair handrail. Minimum plan separation is 0.339935 m.

The selected near-bank scan assembly translates 1.45 m with the path margin. Existing CC0 scans also form a grounded bridge-bank island. Original mesh positions/normals/UVs/PBR are retained within each rigid uniformly scaled scan placement.

camera.reason: The ground-plane horizon, foreground column/eave and terminal-foot visibility jointly support about 1.5 degrees less upward pitch. The eye remains low and the field of view is retained.
camera.dolly: Position control points retained; far viewing attitude follows the same revised reference target.

inspection.scope: Same independent structural QA pose for C and D, through the shared wrapper; not the photographic camera or a film-path replacement

actualReview.front: Foreground eave direction and column/lamp framing, near rail depth, bridge crest/span, hall entry and pagoda spacing visibly improve against the prior actual frame.
actualReview.route: Final actual D side view shows an open turning landing and a continuous unobstructed visible route into the hall stairs. The crossing rail/deck visible in actual C is absent.
limits: Whole photo quality remains unaccepted. Architecture, window/bracing patterns, stone/wetness, foliage, lighting and detail still differ substantially from the reference.
Some pier/bank masses and hidden construction are coarse.
Selected anchor fit and valid rendering do not establish photographic fidelity.
No full seven-second motion revalidation was performed in this bounded pass.

anchorAudit.scope: Manually read whole-assembly anchors, including two projected edge crossings. Diagnostic only, not a fidelity score; several readings have 7–12 pixel uncertainty.

candidateHistory.finding: Broad framing improves, but drain yaw 0.77 overshoots the reference bottom crossing; near terminal proportions remain too wide.
Drain/ground boundaries improve. Contact audit still requires a full upper wedge and wider deck/tread bearings for rail feet.
Side view exposes the inner bridge rail/deck crossing the first hall treads. Not a walkable-route acceptance.
Exact-source front and same side pose verify the corrected open turn and stair/deck separation. No entire-photo-match claim.

validation.actual: Four shared-mutex render-one-reconstruction wrapper jobs, eight valid frames, no render errors
validation.extraJobReason: Parent explicitly authorized one targeted fourth front+same-side job after C exposed the real turn collision; no other tuning followed.

assetPolicy.referenceUse: Comparison input only; no reference RGB/depth is read into rendered surfaces
assetPolicy.drainShaderCoordinateChange: Existing drain exclusion angle follows actual moved slot; no rain/coating calibration pass
assetPolicy.scanTransfer: Existing geometry and PBR retained, rigid placement and uniform scale only

supportVolumeScope: Buried foundations, abutments and bearing joins intentionally share support volumes; the visible stair/deck circulation footprints are separate.
